reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows model LSE4613BD, which is a recalled model.
The claimed purchase date of 2014-04-05 is before the program's sale window, which opens 2015-01-01. Purchases before the window are denied.
The retailer, LG.com, is not on the program's list of sales channels. Under the sale rules, a non-listed retailer would require proof of ownership, but the date denial controls the outcome.
The serial 309KM7640401 is within a recalled range and no duplicate claims were found, so these checks do not change the outcome.
